correctness_confidence.basis: The lower and upper bounds were substantively checked at v003, and v004 adds the requested boundary-singularity argument and precise AJL theorem/equation mapping without changing the main theorem.

novelty.basis: The Grassmannian least-degree law appears to unify and extend several special routing laws; the manuscript now distinguishes it carefully from fixed-domain Tevelev-degree work.

reproducibility.basis: The argument is predominantly symbolic and inspectable; exact witness files support special computations, while numerical searches are labeled as evidence rather than proof.

rigor.basis: The Pluecker-degree lower bound, lossless inner lift, backward-shift state count, base-point additivity, and boundary factorization are presented with explicit proof interfaces.

significance.basis: It gives an exact algebraic degree invariant for a broad passive spectral-routing problem and useful generic/base-point consequences.

strengths: Exact equality between minimum McMillan degree and the least degree of a rational Grassmannian interpolant.
Conceptually clean matching lower and upper bounds through Pluecker projection and a Forney-minimal inner lift.
Useful additivity and base-point laws, plus explicit generic and witness-based consequences.
strong_novelty_candidates: The equality d_min=delta_Gr for arbitrary prescribed k-plane data on the unit circle.
The degree additivity formula under removal of a scalar polynomial gcd, including one degree per interior base point.
The generic value k floor(L/2) in Gr(k,2k), with the explicit graph witness in the balanced case.
summary: The v004 revision resolves the remaining citation, boundary, and comparison requests from my v003 assessment. In particular, it pins the Agler–John–Lykova realization theorem to its exact parts and equations, proves that a possible boundary zero of det(H_P) is removable in P H_P^{-1}, and gives a disciplined comparison with fixed-domain Tevelev degrees. I found no material objection to the exact Grassmannian degree law or its stated corollaries.
weaknesses: Several generic-position consequences still rely on exact witness computations or numerical detector searches rather than a uniform symbolic classification.
Novelty relative to the broad interpolation and quantum-Schubert literature was checked only through the targeted sources discussed in this assessment.
